t: The LAP Sul outdoor LED wall light is a solar-powered security light designed to illuminate external spaces automatically. This wall-mounted fixture is ideal for domestic driveways, gardens, and pathways, providing reliable illumination for homeowners and trade professionals installing exterior security. The unit features an integrated daylight LED that delivers 240 lumens of bright light through a durable polycarbonate diffuser. An integrated PIR sensor detects motion up to 8m away across a 120° angle, whilst the pre-set dusk-to-dawn sensor ensures the light only operates when needed to conserve battery power.
